issues.description: The problem statement and UML require a constructor that initializes all five attributes (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) in that order, and the solution implements a 5-parameter constructor. The template, however, provides a constructor with only three parameters (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This mismatch can confuse students and cause tests expecting a 5-argument constructor to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the template to provide a constructor signature that matches the UML and the solution: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) { ... } and/or remove the incomplete 3-parameter constructor so students implement the correct 5-parameter constructor as specified.
